_comment: Allowlist of bundled armies (res://armies/<id>.json) shown in the army-select dropdowns (Main Menu, Plan Editor, Multiplayer Lobby, Web Lobby). Any bundled army NOT listed here is hidden from players but still loadable by tests/fixtures/tutorials by id. Armies the player imports into user://armies/ are always shown. To show/hide a bundled army, edit this list — read by ArmyListManager.get_selectable_armies(). Set ArmyListManager.show_all_armies = true to bypass (dev/tests).
